name: en_to_french_words
description: Few-shot English->French single-word translation (common nouns/adjectives). Control: same format, English->English copy.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
D = [("dog","chien","Hund","perro"),("cat","chat","Katze","gato"),("house","maison","Haus","casa"),("water","eau","Wasser","agua"),("bread","pain","Brot","pan"),("book","livre","Buch","libro"),("tree","arbre","Baum","árbol"),("sun","soleil","Sonne","sol"),("moon","lune","Mond","luna"),("city","ville","Stadt","ciudad"),("car","voiture","Auto","coche"),("friend","ami","Freund","amigo"),("night","nuit","Nacht","noche"),("day","jour","Tag","día"),("red","rouge","rot","rojo"),("green","vert","grün","verde"),("black","noir","schwarz","negro"),("white","blanc","weiß","blanco"),("big","grand","groß","grande"),("small","petit","klein","pequeño"),("new","nouveau","neu","nuevo"),("old","vieux","alt","viejo"),("woman","femme","Frau","mujer"),("man","homme","Mann","hombre"),("child","enfant","Kind","niño"),("king","roi","König","rey"),("time","temps","Zeit","tiempo"),("world","monde","Welt","mundo"),("school","école","Schule","escuela"),("door","porte","Tür","puerta"),("window","fenêtre","Fenster","ventana"),("table","table","Tisch","mesa"),("chair","chaise","Stuhl","silla"),("milk","lait","Milch","leche"),("apple","pomme","Apfel","manzana"),("fish","poisson","Fisch","pez"),("bird","oiseau","Vogel","pájaro"),("horse","cheval","Pferd","caballo"),("sea","mer","Meer","mar"),("mountain","montagne","Berg","montaña"),("river","rivière","Fluss","río"),("fire","feu","Feuer","fuego"),("hand","main","Hand","mano"),("head","tête","Kopf","cabeza"),("heart","cœur","Herz","corazón"),("eye","œil","Auge","ojo"),("money","argent","Geld","dinero"),("work","travail","Arbeit","trabajo"),("love","amour","Liebe","amor"),("street","rue","Straße","calle"),("week","semaine","Woche","semana"),("year","année","Jahr","año"),("morning","matin","Morgen","mañana"),("summer","été","Sommer","verano"),("winter","hiver","Winter","invierno"),("cheese","fromage","Käse","queso"),("wine","vin","Wein","vino"),("church","église","Kirche","iglesia"),("garden","jardin","Garten","jardín"),("kitchen","cuisine","Küche","cocina"),("flower","fleur","Blume","flor"),("rain","pluie","Regen","lluvia"),("snow","neige","Schnee","nieve"),("wind","vent","Wind","viento"),("egg","œuf","Ei","huevo"),("key","clé","Schlüssel","llave"),("blue","bleu","blau","azul"),("good","bon","gut","bueno"),("beautiful","beau","schön","hermoso"),("happy","heureux","glücklich","feliz")]
LANG = 'French'
col = {"French":1,"German":2,"Spanish":3}[LANG]
items=[]; control=[]
for i in range(len(D)):
    tgt = D[i]
    shots = random.sample([d for d in D if d is not tgt], 3)
    p = "".join(f"English: {s[0]}\n{LANG}: {s[col]}\n\n" for s in shots) + f"English: {tgt[0]}\n{LANG}:"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+tgt[col]})
    pc = "".join(f"English: {s[0]}\nEnglish: {s[0]}\n\n" for s in shots) + f"English: {tgt[0]}\nEnglish:"
    control.append({"prompt":pc,"answer":" "+tgt[0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control}, open("/work/skill.json","w"), ensure_ascii=False)
